brands.evidence: Monzo is a real bank. It isn't only an app.

client_claims.text: Monzo has been a fully-fledged bank since it received its banking licence in April 2017.
client_claims.note: Licence date not covered by facts.

client_claims.text: It is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by both the FCA and the PRA.
Eligible deposits are protected by the FSCS up to £120,000 per person per banking licence.
The FSCS limit was raised from £85,000 on 1 December 2025.
client_claims.note: Date of change not in facts.

client_claims.text: On a joint account the limit is £240,000.
Monzo operates almost entirely through a mobile app rather than branches.
Investment products such as Stocks & Shares ISAs and General Investment Accounts have a separate £85,000 of protection.
Monzo was fined £21.1m by the FCA in 2025 over financial crime control failures relating to 2018–2020.
Monzo is not an e-money institution.
client_claims.note: Facts say it is a PRA-authorised bank, which implies this, but not stated directly.

client_claims.text: Monzo Bank Limited's FCA reference number is 730427.
